svg.title: Takeaway
svg.desc: Return to the executive summary. C1 remembers occurrences; C2 owns admitted beliefs and inherited evidence; the pure PLN kernel calculates; C3 ranks; C4 reserves and reconciles bounded work. The practical result is one actual native Hive inference action and a controlled independent attention replacement, preserving the M1/M2 application-neutral DA and authorization boundaries. The result is bounded local integration, not general reasoning or production deployment. All thirteen required gates pass, no supported prerequisite is blocked, and chain remains NOT_RUN. The deck and this work stop at M3.
svg.text: Real Hive + native PLN + replaceable attention
with explicit private owners and tested recovery.
